name: Launceston City Park
objection: Ordinary city park with one source; only the monkeys set it apart.

name: Queen Victoria Museum & Art Gallery
objection: Low page views; two sites (Inveresk, Royal Park) may blur which one is the spot.

name: Boag's Brewery
objection: Only one source, and it is a bookable tour at a hotel centre rather than a free-roaming place.

name: Tasmania Zoo
objection: One source and a zoo far from the centre; Tasmanian wildlife is available elsewhere.

name: Tamar Island Wetlands
objection: Short, local-feeling wetland walk close to the city.

name: Franklin House
objection: Case for: open heritage house a guide names. Against: one source, 30 min, typical local-heritage stop and the app has stronger heritage draws (Brickendon, Woolmers).

name: Entally House
objection: Case for: 1819 estate and gardens named by a guide. Against: single source, access days uncertain, short visit.

name: Design Centre Tasmania
objection: Case for: unique wood-design collection, free to look. Against: one source filed under shopping, gallery visit is short and close to City Park.

name: Duck Reach Power Station
objection: Part of the Cataract Gorge reserve; the walk could be folded into the Gorge spot.

name: Brady's Lookout
objection: A roadside lookout, 20-30 min; coordinates must be a feature, not the highway.

name: Jansz Tasmania
objection: Case for: widely recommended standout of the valley, with a lake or homestead setting. Against: still a winery venue and the Tamar Valley Wine Route already covers wineries.

name: Josef Chromy
objection: Case for: widely recommended standout of the valley, with a lake or homestead setting. Against: still a winery venue and the Tamar Valley Wine Route already covers wineries.

name: Tamar Ridge Wines
objection: Case for: widely recommended standout of the valley, with a lake or homestead setting. Against: still a winery venue and the Tamar Valley Wine Route already covers wineries.

name: Low Head Lighthouse
objection: One source and a lighthouse that may only be viewed from outside.

name: Pilots Station and Museum
objection: Case for: five-room museum and free grounds, a half-hour stop. Against: near-duplicate of the lighthouse spot (same headland), one source.

name: Watch House
objection: Case for: open to the public and in the combined George Town ticket. Against: one source, small local museum.

name: Bass and Flinders Centre
objection: One source and a small museum, but boarding a replica ship is a real activity.

name: George Town
objection: As a spot its attractions are listed separately; it may be better folded into a Tamar destination.

name: Platypus House
objection: One source; Wikivoyage hours (10-3:30) are old.

name: Seahorse World
objection: Wikivoyage link is dead, and it may have changed hours/ownership; one source.

name: Beaconsfield Mine & Heritage Centre
objection: One source and 775 page views for the museum itself, though the 2006 rescue is well known.

name: Fly By Night Creek Fossicking Area
objection: Case for: a distinct, free hands-on activity. Against: one source, remote crossing on a road with nothing to see.

name: Longford
objection: Case for: historic town visitors stop in. Against: wrapper for Brickendon and Woolmers, town lists only restaurants.

name: Brickendon Estate
objection: Single source in our list, but it is a World Heritage site.

name: Woolmers Estate
objection: Single source in our list, but a World Heritage site.

name: Perth
objection: Case for: heritage town on the way from Hobart. Against: no sight of its own after the church and pubs are removed.

name: Australian Fly Fishing Museum
objection: Case for: distinct, specific museum. Against: niche, one source, stale open status, in Nile.

name: Bridport
objection: Case for: coastal town with beaches that a guide covers. Against: its sights are weak ('Just another beach'), mostly a golf and ferry base.

name: Barnbougle Dunes
objection: Case for: famous dune golf resort that people travel for. Against: a paid golf venue, one source, a dead link.

name: Bridestowe Lavender Estate
objection: Peak bloom is Dec-Jan and entry is charged then; off-season it is a shop and cafe.

name: St Helens
objection: Few sights of its own; may be better as a destination than a spot.

name: St Helens History Room
objection: Case for: open daily, 1000 artefacts. Against: one source, small local museum.

name: Mainly Maritime
objection: Case for: unusual collection. Against: one source, privately run niche museum.

name: Serpentarium Wildlife Park
objection: Case for: rainy-day wildlife stop. Against: one source, small private exhibit.

name: St Helens Mountain Bike Trails
objection: Wikivoyage's listing reads like the trail operator's own copy; a network not a place.

name: Georges Bay Foreshore Trail
objection: Case for: easy walk or ride. Against: a linear local path, one source.

name: Binalong Bay
objection: Part of the Bay of Fires spot; kept as the distinct village/beach at the southern access.

name: Eddystone Point Lighthouse
objection: One source; lighthouse grounds and exterior viewing only, and sits inside Mount William NP.

name: Scamander
objection: Case for: second-tier beach town a guide covers. Against: one source and no See listing.

name: Eureka Farm
objection: Case for: family stop. Against: one source, a working farm shop, seasonal.

name: Ansons Bay
objection: Case for: quiet bay. Against: one source, mainly fishing, few things to do.

name: Musselroe Bay
objection: Case for: remote coast. Against: one source, mainly fishing.

name: wukalina Walk
objection: The name wukalina Walk is also the guided Aboriginal multi-day experience; name the spot Mount William (wukalina) summit walk.

name: Cobler Rocks Walk
objection: Part of Mount William NP; one source.

name: Ben Lomond National Park
objection: None serious; it is also the park-level destination candidate.

name: Ben Lomond Ski Field
objection: Could be one spot with the park; separated only because skiing is a distinct activity.

name: Legges Tor
objection: Case for: summit with a name. Against: part of the park walks and one source.

name: Jacobs Ladder
objection: Case for: distinct drive/lookout. Against: part of the park entry road, a road not a place.

name: Carr Villa to Alpine Village Walk
objection: Case for: the main named hike. Against: one source, a route to the village not a place.

name: Stacks Bluff
objection: Case for: 1527 m cliff peak, a hard walk. Against: one source and a remote challenging walk.

name: Blue Tier
objection: Case for: forest and mining heritage. Against: a region not a single place; key walks are closed.

name: Pyengana Dairy
objection: A cheese shop and cafe, so close to a food venue; rated well and a regional icon.

name: St Columba Falls
objection: None serious.

name: Little Blue Lake
objection: Swimming is not recommended; a 15 min roadside look; it is in Derby area and may lie outside this region.
